acceptedScope: Persisted same-Run reservation before one internal callback attempt
Per-call acquired ownership, concurrent and normal-close/reopen duplicate refusal
Submitted versus uncertain settlement, save-failure reservation preservation and late-result refusal
Snapshot claim protection and old prepared record compatibility
limitations: Same Run/Store only, not arbitrary cross-Run/Session remote exactly-once
Existing rename without fsync, no power-loss durability proof
Timeout does not cancel remote work; no automatic recovery/release/retry
Request fingerprint is a supplied binding, not connected full-context/human/money authorization
No actual guard/dispatch/terminal-return integration, model Run or desktop deployment
